Package common.hardware.motorcontroller

Class NAR_CANSpark

java.lang.Object
common.hardware.motorcontroller.NAR_Motor
common.hardware.motorcontroller.NAR_CANSpark
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class NAR_CANSpark extends NAR_Motor
A REV Spark MAX or Spark Flex motor controller, which drives NEO, NEO 550 and NEO Vortex motors, using REVLib.

Every setting is kept in one SparkBaseConfig. Changing a setting updates it and sends it to the Spark without saving it; NAR_Robot saves every Spark's settings to flash once after startup, as REV recommends (see burnFlash()).

The Spark's own control loops measure in rotations and rotations per minute, output a fraction of 12 V, and run every millisecond. NAR_Motor converts gains and setpoints to and from your units.

It can read either the motor's built-in encoder or an absolute encoder plugged into the Spark; see NAR_CANSpark.EncoderType.

Since:
2023 Charged Up

      Create a new object to control a SPARK motor

      deviceNumber - The device ID.
      controllerType - The type of controller used, ie. CAN_SPARK_MAX or CAN_SPARK_FLEX
      encoderType - The type of encoder used, ie. relative build in encoder or absolute encoder connected by an adapter.

    • setSupplyLimit

      public void setSupplyLimit(int limit)
      Sets REV's "secondary current limit". Sparks don't have a true battery-side (supply) limit like a TalonFX, so this is the closest thing: if the motor's current goes over it, the Spark cuts its output for a moment. Keep it above setStatorLimit(int), which does the everyday limiting.
      Specified by:
      setSupplyLimit in class NAR_Motor
      Parameters:
      limit - Amps

    • setPeriodicFramePeriod

      public void setPeriodicFramePeriod(com.revrobotics.spark.SparkLowLevel.PeriodicFrame frame, int periodMs)
      Set the rate of transmission for periodic frames from the SPARK MAX

      Each motor controller sends back status frames with different data at set rates. Use this function to change the default rates.

      Status 0: Applied Output, Faults, Sticky Faults, isFollower

      Status 1: Motor Velocity, Motor Temperature, Motor Voltage, Motor Current

      Status 2: Motor Position

      Status 3: Analog Sensor Voltage, Analog Sensor Velocity, Analog Sensor Position

      Status 4: Alternate Encoder Velocity

      Status 5: Duty Cycle Absolute Encoder Position, Duty Cycle Absolute Encoder Absolute Angle

      Status 6: Duty Cycle Absolute Encoder Velocity, Duty Cycle Absolute Encoder Frequency

      Parameters:
      frame - Which type of SparkLowLevel.PeriodicFrame to change the period of
      periodMs - Period in ms for the given frame.

    • setPeriodicFramePeriodNoApply

      public void setPeriodicFramePeriodNoApply(com.revrobotics.spark.SparkLowLevel.PeriodicFrame frame, int periodMs)
      Stores a frame's rate, without sending it yet. REVLib sets rates per signal rather than per frame, so this sets every signal the frame carries. Frame 4, an alternate encoder, isn't supported and is ignored.

      protected void simulationStep(double dtSeconds)
      Follows REV's SparkSim pattern. The built-in encoder has no conversion factor, so iterate() takes rotor RPM. An absolute encoder is moved by the motor's motion divided by NAR_Motor.setMotorRotationsPerSensorRotation(double).
      Overrides:
      simulationStep in class NAR_Motor
